title: Split and Merge: Aligning Position Biases in LLM-based Evaluators
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on mitigating position bias in LLM-based evaluators across general categories like writing, roleplay, reasoning, math, coding, extraction, STEM, and humanities.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
